articles.title: Fastly Appoints Joan Jenkins as Chief Marketing Officer to Accelerate Growth and Market Leadership
articles.mainIdea: Fastly Appoints Joan Jenkins as Chief Marketing Officer to Accelerate Growth and Market Leadership
articles.summary: Business Wire: Fastly Appoints Joan Jenkins as Chief Marketing Officer to Accelerate Growth and Market Leadership. SAN FRANCISCO, March 31, 2026--Fastly, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLY), a leading global edge cloud platform, today announced the appointment of marketing executive Joan Jenkins as Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). Jenkins will lead global marketing and focus on helping the company accelerate growth and further its leadership in security and edge computing, as well as scaling AI workloads.
